SNL-Basics owns a domain-neutral SNL parser, tree/semantic utilities, Macro template resolution, rendering, and injectable interaction mechanisms. It does not own mathematical terminology, an Entry database, a workspace writer, a filesystem, editor routing, or a Lean elaborator.

The consumer supplies `MacroDataQueries`, `EntryDataQueries`, language/theme context, source activation, and any additional block renderers. `.SNL_Doc` is documentation data consumed through those mechanisms; the repository's TypeScript/API terminology is not a built-in mathematical ontology.

Public imports are the package root and the subpaths declared in `package.json#exports`: `/core`, `/runtime`, `/hover`, `/entry`, `/style.css`, and `/entry/style.css`. A file present under `src/` or `dist-lib/` is not automatically a public import. `/entry` is optional and owns the Markdown dependency chain; the package root must not acquire it merely to render a syntax tree.

Renderer output and publication/export are different layers. Typst/PDF generation, standalone HTML packaging, workspace mutations, and editor Pointer resolution belong to consumer products. Basics can display a Typst source body but does not compile it into a typeset document.
